summary: The fight stays in Stohess, among residents and flat streets. Annie is not captured. The last fact is a face inside the wall.

segments.ja: ストヘス区の戦闘は、もう地下の計画ではありません。女型の巨人とエレンの戦場は、屋根と通りの上です。調査兵団の作戦は捕獲のままですが、場所が日常の街になりました。日常だった幅に、巨人の足が入ります。入った瞬間、住民の速度と兵士の速度は同じ通りを共有します。共有は、合意ではありません。合意のない共有が、今日の被害の始まりです。始まりを止められる時間は、すでに短くなっています。
segments.en: The fighting in Stohess District is no longer the underground plan. The battlefield of the Female Titan and Eren is on the roofs and the streets. The Survey Corps' operation is still capture, but the place has become an ordinary city. A Titan's foot enters a width that had been ordinary. At the moment it enters, the residents' speed and the soldiers' speed share the same street. Sharing is not agreement. Sharing without agreement is the start of today's damage. The time in which the start could have been stopped is already short.

segments.ja: 被害は、敵を倒した数では数えられません。崩れた壁際、落ちた屋根、逃げ遅れた人の通り。エレンが拳を出せば、拳の届く範囲も被害に入ります。出さなければ、女型の巨人の範囲が被害になります。どちらにしても街は無傷で終わりません。ジャンはその無傷の不在を、作戦の失敗とは別の失敗として見ます。別の失敗の名は、住民を計算の外に置けなかったことです。置けなかったことを、彼は刃の位置で最小にしようとします。
segments.en: Damage is not a count of enemies brought down. A broken edge, a fallen roof, a street of people late to flee. If Eren puts a fist out, its reach enters the damage. If he does not, the Female Titan's reach does. Either way the city does not end unhurt. Jean calls that a second failure: the residents could not be left out of the calculation. He tries to keep it small with the place of his blade.

segments.ja: エルヴィンが作戦を残す理由は、人類です。女型の巨人の中身が、壁の外と壁の内を繋ぐ情報を持っている。その情報を取ることが、人類の次の生存に要る。大きい言葉です。大きい言葉の下で、今日死ぬのは通りの幅にいる少数です。少数を大きい言葉で割ると、一人の重さは小さく見えます。ジャンは割り算を拒否します。団長は割り算を、知ったうえで使います。使うことが冷たいのではなく、使わない場合の全滅を、彼はより冷たい未来として見ています。
segments.en: Erwin keeps the operation for humanity. The Female Titan's contents hold information linking the outside of the walls and the inside. Taking it is, he says, what humanity needs next. It is a large word. Under it, the people who die today are the few in one street's width. Divide the few by the large word and one life looks small. Jean refuses that division. The Commander uses it anyway. He sees total loss, if he does not, as the colder future.

segments.ja: 立体機動装置は、高い足場があるときに速くなります。ストヘス区の戦いの一部は平地です。平地ではワイヤーの先がなく、兵士は女型の巨人の足もとに近づきすぎます。近づきすぎた速度は、技術ではなく犠牲に近くなります。調査兵団はその近さを知って、なお網とワイヤーで逃走の方向を絞ります。絞る作業は綺麗な空中戦ではありません。綺麗でない作業を、ジャンは街の被害を増やさない範囲で引き受けます。範囲は、すぐに破れます。
segments.en: ODM gear is fast when the footing is high. Part of Stohess is flat ground. There a wire has no far point, and soldiers come too close to the Female Titan's feet. That closeness is sacrifice, not technique. Knowing it, the Survey Corps still uses a net and wires to narrow her escape. The work is not a clean fight in the air. Jean takes it on without adding to the damage. The limit tears almost at once.

segments.en: Soldiers stay in the street in order to break the escape. Staying is an order, and the contents of the order are a sacrifice. A sacrifice can be reshaped later as a story of heroes. Before the reshaping, on the street, they disappear one by one. Eren cannot help seeing that way of disappearing laid over the day of his squad. The overlapped eyes both strengthen the fist and delay it again. If it is delayed, the next sacrifice is bought. If it is strengthened, a different damage flies toward the residents. Neither one is a clean victory.

segments.ja: エレンが殴っているのは、数時間前まで護送の列にいた顔です。味方だった時間と、敵である現在が、同じ巨人の体にあります。人間性を捨てた、と彼は言い切れません。言い切れないまま、うなじを意識して拳を選びます。選ぶことが、鉄槌の日に残した覚悟を実行することです。実行は不完全です。不完全な拳でも、女型の巨人の硬化に当たり、当たらない場所を探します。探しているあいだも、街の被害は止まりません。
segments.en: Eren is hitting a face that was in the escort column a few hours ago. Ally and enemy are in the same Titan body. He cannot say her humanity was simply thrown away. He still chooses the fist with the nape in mind. That choice carries out the resolve from the day of the crushing blow, and the carrying-out is incomplete. He writes the residents' damage and the soldiers' sacrifice into his own margin instead. The margin fills at once. He will not turn the page into a victory report. segments.en: Capture comes close to failing once more, after the forest. The Female Titan looks as if she has fallen, and she does not hand over the contents. segments.en: Stohess District after the fighting drops resembles the day the expedition came through the gate. There is no cheer. Only empty places, and broken buildings, speak the result. The Survey Corps does not call the result a victory for humanity. The reason not to call it that is that the contents are silent, the residents are hurt, and the sacrifice is left in the street. Jean walks the remaining street ahead of the diagram being right. His walking speed at last returns to the residents' speed. What can be seen at the returned speed is a hole that was not there before the operation.

segments.ja: 穴の先で、壁そのものが別の事実を見せます。石の内側に、巨人の顔があります。壁は人が積んだ防壁であると同時に、誰かの体を覆って立っています。覆っていたものが、今日の戦闘で露出しました。露出は、王政が簡単に公表できる情報ではありません。公表できない情報が、季節の最後に調査兵団の前へ出ます。エレンは顔を、女型の巨人の中身とは別の巨大さとして見ます。別の巨大さは、まだ名前を持ちません。
segments.en: Beyond the hole, the wall itself shows a different fact. Inside the stone, there is a Titan's face. The wall is a barrier people built, and at the same time it is standing there covering someone's body. What had been covered was exposed by today's fighting. The exposure is not information the royal government can easily publish. Information that cannot be published comes out in front of the Survey Corps at the end of the season. Eren sees the face as a vastness different from the contents of the Female Titan. The other vastness does not yet have a name.

segments.en: Today's words. Damage is the price of Stohess District becoming a battlefield. Residents are the people who did not agree to that price. A sacrifice is the soldiers who stayed in the street to break the escape. Humanity is the large reason Erwin kept the operation. The wall is the structure that protects the city, and today it showed a Titan's face on its inside. Annie's contents were not taken. What was taken was hardening, failure, and the fact inside the wall. The fact becomes the first page of the next season.

He tries to keep it small with the place of his blade.

vocab.exampleEn: Armin stands at the street's edge as the person whose diagram was right. Being right did not save Annie. He does not move that responsibility onto Eren's late fist. He writes the residents' damage and the soldiers' sacrifice into his own margin instead. The margin fills at once. He will not turn the page into a victory report. At most it is a warning not to bring the same gap of speed into a city again. The warning is too late for today.

vocab.exampleJa: 女型の巨人は倒れたように見えて、中身を渡しません。
vocab.exampleEn: Capture comes close to failing once more, after the forest. The Female Titan looks as if she has fallen, and she does not hand over the contents. Eren lowers the fist, and at the place he lowers it he cannot find the classmate's face. Not finding it is the last line of mercy's bill. The line is not marked paid.

vocab.exampleJa: 石の内側に、巨人の顔があります。
vocab.exampleEn: Beyond the hole, the wall itself shows a different fact. Inside the stone, there is a Titan's face. Eren sees the face as a vastness different from the contents of the Female Titan. The other vastness does not yet have a name.

vocab.exampleJa: 調査兵団の作戦は捕獲のままですが、場所が日常の街になりました。
vocab.exampleEn: The fighting in Stohess District is no longer the underground plan. The battlefield of the Female Titan and Eren is on the roofs and the streets. At the moment it enters, the residents' speed and the soldiers' speed share the same street. Sharing is not agreement. Sharing without agreement is the start of today's damage. The time in which the start could have been stopped is already short.

vocab.exampleJa: 帳消しにできないまま、彼は中身を取り逃がす未来のほうが長い、と判断します。
vocab.exampleEn: If the operation fails, another capture attempt is not the only thing waiting. Eren's custody and the Survey Corps' standing move toward execution and disbanding. He still judges that letting the contents escape is the longer loss. No one on the street gets that judgment explained.

vocab.exampleEn: Eren is hitting a face that was in the escort column a few hours ago. Ally and enemy are in the same Titan body. He cannot say her humanity was simply thrown away.
